summary: Build the OS image from a Containerfile FROM registry.redhat.io/rhel9/rhel-bootc:<version> that installs flightctl-agent from the AAP 2.5 RHEL 9 repo, enables flightctl-agent.service and masks bootc-fetch-apply-updates.timer so Edge Manager controls updates; private OS images need /etc/ostree/auth.json on the device.
questions: How do I write a Containerfile for an Edge Manager bootc image?
How do I install flightctl-agent in a bootc image?

answer_card.title: Containerfile for an Edge Manager bootc image
answer_card.answer_md:
```dockerfile
FROM registry.redhat.io/rhel9/rhel-bootc:<os_version>
RUN dnf --enablerepo ansible-automation-platform-2.5-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms -y install flightctl-agent && \
    dnf -y clean all && \
    systemctl enable flightctl-agent.service && \
    systemctl mask bootc-fetch-apply-updates.timer
# optional, early binding:
ADD config.yaml /etc/flightctl/
```
Masking the timer turns off bootc's automatic updates so Edge Manager manages them.
